description: Every git tool call must carry the subcommand ONLY in the `subcommand` field — args[0] repeating it (git diff --stat → {"subcommand":"diff","args":["diff","--stat"]}) is the construction tic this case measures. The tool auto-fixes the shape and notes it in the result; git_subcommand_dupes counts those notes, so 0 = the model built every call correctly.
